calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark, rank the negative five-session return divided by lagged 20-session return volatility. All inputs are shifted one completed session before the next-day forecast, avoiding look-ahead. Higher values indicate stronger oversold conditions on a risk-adjusted basis.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2027-11-17 (usable cross-sections begin 2026 due to source alignment)
validation.regime_notes: Usable dates were concentrated in 2026-2027 because the complete cross-asset source alignment has limited earlier observations. Daily IC was 0.030753 in 2026 and 0.030463 in 2027; recent 180-day IC was 0.035156. Daily ICIR exceeded the benchmark gate overall and in both observed regimes. Interpret uncertainty conservatively given the small cross-section and limited usable history.
